test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

He is / the more intelligent / and hardworking student / of our class.
solution:
The erroneous part is** 'the more intelligent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'the most intelligent' **should be used instead of** 'the more intelligent'.**
 
• There are different ways to form the **comparative** and **superlative** **degrees of adjectives.**
 
• Add -**er **or **more** to form the comparative of most **one-syllable **and **two-syllable adjectives.**
 
• **'More, most, less, or least'** are added to **adjectives** of three or **more syllables** to form the **superlative**. 
 
• In the given sentence '**Intelligent**' has **4 syllables** and the stress is on the **second syllable**.
 
 
• *Example: I think it is **the most beautiful** of all the palms.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *He is **the most intelligent **and hardworking student of our class.*
